name: wiki
description: Notes and documents for humans and agents: nested pages with a page tree, a Markdown editor with preview, links between pages with backlinks, mentions of people and links to tasks, deals and other items as @{app:type:id}, favorites, full-text search and a history of every change with restore. Every page is also delivered to the shared search (Knowledge).

requiredTables.name: pages
requiredTables.description: Wiki pages: title, Markdown content, tags, parent page, archive timestamp and a full-text index (Postgres English dictionary).

requiredTables.name: page_revisions
requiredTables.description: History: the state of every page after every change (create, edit, move, restore, archive), with parent page, author (human or agent) and timestamp. Never modified.

requiredTables.name: page_favorites
requiredTables.description: Favorites: which person or agent marked which page, and when.

requiredTables.name: page_links
requiredTables.description: Links between pages ([text](page:<id>) in the content), kept in step with the content; the source of backlinks.

requiredTables.name: search_outbox
requiredTables.description: Pages waiting to be delivered to the shared search (Knowledge): one row per page, written in the same transaction as the change, with a version, attempts and the last error. Deleted after delivery.

requiredTables.name: search_sync
requiredTables.description: One row: when all pages were last queued for the shared search.

requiredTables.name: event_outbox
requiredTables.description: Events waiting to be delivered to the platform (page changed, for people who marked it as a favorite): one row per event, written in the same transaction as the change, with attempts and the last error. Deleted after delivery.

requiredTables.name: refs_outbox
requiredTables.description: References waiting to be delivered to the platform (set_refs): one row per page with the full set of its @{app:type:id} references and mentions, written in the same transaction as the change. Deleted after delivery.

offeredTools.name: pages.list
offeredTools.description: Lists non-archived pages without content. Optional: q (text in the title), parentId (only direct subpages), tag, sort ('title' default, or 'updated' = recently edited first), limit (1 to 500, default 500). Returns {pages: [{id, parentId, title, tags, updatedAt, updatedBy}], truncated}; truncated=true means more pages match. For the hierarchy use pages.tree, to search content pages.search.

offeredTools.name: pages.tree
offeredTools.description: The page tree without content. Optional: rootId (UUID) returns that page with all its subpages; without it you get every non-archived page from the top level down. Returns {tree: [{id, title, updatedAt, children: [...]}], truncated}. At most 500 pages, cut level by level; if truncated=true, ask again with a rootId further down. Unknown rootId: 404.

offeredTools.name: pages.get
offeredTools.description: Reads a page in full. Argument: id (UUID). Returns {id, parentId, title, contentMd (Markdown), tags, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy, archivedAt, parent ({id, title} or null), children (live subpages), path (ancestors, top first, for breadcrumbs), backlinks (live pages that link here)}. Unknown id: 404.

offeredTools.name: pages.search
offeredTools.description: Full-text search in title and content of non-archived pages, English dictionary: word forms match, stop words are ignored. Arguments: query ("exact phrase", -word excludes, or combines), limit (optional, 1 to 50, default 10). Returns {hits: [{id, parentId, title, tags, updatedAt, rank, snippet, url, kind}]}, best first; snippet marks hits with «…», url is the page path (/pages/<id>). Also the wiki's tool for the platform search.

offeredTools.name: pages.create
offeredTools.description: Creates a page and the first history entry. Arguments: title (1 to 200 characters), contentMd (Markdown, may be empty), parentId (optional, a non-archived page; the new page becomes its subpage), tags (optional, at most 20 short words). Link to another page with [text](page:<id>); mention someone or link an item of another app with @{human:<email>} or @{app:type:id}. Returns the page like pages.get. Check with pages.search first whether the page exists.

offeredTools.name: pages.update
offeredTools.description: Changes a page and writes a history entry with you as author. Arguments: id plus at least one of: title; contentMd (replaces all content); appendMd (appends after a blank line; not with contentMd); tags (replaces all). To add to a page prefer appendMd. Link to another page with [text](page:<id>); mention someone or link an item of another app with @{human:<email>} or @{app:type:id}. Returns the page like pages.get. Archived pages: 400. To change the parent use pages.move.

offeredTools.name: pages.move
offeredTools.description: Moves a page with all its subpages. Arguments: id; parentId = UUID of the new parent page, or null for the top level (required, so the intent is explicit). Rejected with 400: the page itself or one of its own subpages as parent (that would be a cycle), an archived page or parent. Unknown page or parent: 404. Writes a history entry 'move'. Returns the page like pages.get.

offeredTools.name: pages.archive
offeredTools.description: Archives a page: it disappears from pages.list, pages.tree and pages.search and stays readable with pages.get and pages.history. Cannot be undone through the tools. Argument: id. With non-archived subpages you get 400 with their names; archive or move them first. Returns {id, archivedAt}. Archiving again changes nothing.

offeredTools.name: pages.history
offeredTools.description: History of a page, newest first, also for archived pages. Arguments: id, limit (optional, 1 to 200, default 50). Returns {pageId, title, revisions: [{id, change (create, update, move, restore or archive), parentId, title, contentMd, tags, editedBy, editedAt}]}. Each revision is the state after the change; editedBy is a person id or agent:<name>. Use a revision id with pages.restore.

offeredTools.name: pages.restore
offeredTools.description: Restores title, content and tags of a page to an earlier revision and writes a new history entry 'restore'; nothing is deleted, the parent stays. Arguments: id; revisionId (the id string from pages.history). Archived page: 400. Unknown page or revision of another page: 404. Returns the page like pages.get. If the page already matches the revision, nothing is written.

offeredTools.name: pages.resolve
offeredTools.description: Resolves page references (wiki:page:<id>) for chips in other apps. Arguments: type (page), ids (1 to 50 page ids). Returns {objects: [{id, title, path, status, updatedAt}]}; unknown ids are left out, archived pages have status Archived. The platform calls it for resolve_refs after checking that the viewer may read the wiki.

offeredTools.name: favorites.list
offeredTools.description: Your own favorite pages (the caller's, person or agent), non-archived, sorted by title. No arguments. Returns {pages: [{id, parentId, title, tags, updatedAt, updatedBy}]}.

offeredTools.name: favorites.set
offeredTools.description: Adds a page to your own favorites or removes it. Arguments: id; favorite (true adds, false removes). Idempotent. An archived page cannot be added (400) but can be removed. Unknown page: 404. Returns {id, favorite}. People with a favorite get a notification in their platform inbox (Home) when someone else changes the page.

offeredTools.name: search.backfill
offeredTools.description: Queues every page for the shared search of the platform (Knowledge) and delivers as many as fit into about 20 seconds; the rest follows in the background. Archived pages are removed there. Use after the first rollout or when search.status shows stuck pages. Returns {queued, delivered, failed, pending, stopped, lastError}.

offeredTools.name: search.status
offeredTools.description: Shows how many pages wait to be delivered to the shared search (Knowledge), how many failed and why (errors: pageId, attempts, lastError), and when all pages were last queued. permission_denied in lastError means the grant for app:wiki on knowledge.documents.upsert/remove is missing.

events.description: The title, content or tags of a page changed (edited or restored). Goes to everyone who marked the page as a favorite.

objects.description: A wiki page with its title. Reference: wiki:page:<id>.

requestedGrants.reason: Who may open the wiki. Which group is decided by the grant in the control plane; a requested right is a request, not an assignment.
The wiki delivers every page to the shared search. Without this grant pages wait in the outbox; saving in the wiki is never affected.
Archived pages are removed from the shared search. Without this grant they stay findable there until it is granted.
The wiki tells people who follow a page (favorites) that it changed, through the platform inbox. Without this grant events wait in the outbox; saving in the wiki is never affected.

The wiki reports the @{app:type:id} references and mentions on a page, so other apps show the page as a backlink and mentioned people get a notification in their inbox. Without this grant references wait in the outbox; saving in the wiki is never affected.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Connection to the app's own schema, using the app role. Set by the control plane.

env.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
env.description: The app's own schema. The SDK derives the search_path from it; a DSN with options= is rejected.

env.name: OPENAPPS_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: App-specific secret the SDK uses to verify the gateway signature. Set by the control plane per deployment.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_ID
env.description: Id of this app in the signed material. Must be byte-identical to what the gateway writes.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_HOST
env.description: Shared domain in the signed material, trimmed and lowercased.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_BASE_PATH
env.description: Path the app lives under (/wiki). Must be set at build time, otherwise links and images point nowhere.

env.name: OPENAPPS_PLATFORM_URL
env.description: Address of the control plane in the platform network. The SDK calls Knowledge and delivers events and references through it (callAppTool). Set by the control plane.

env.name: OPENAPPS_CALL_SECRET
env.description: The app's own secret for calls to other apps through the platform. Set by the control plane per deployment; never logged.

egress.reason: Calls to other apps and to the platform go through the control plane (OPENAPPS_PLATFORM_URL): delivering pages to the shared search, events to the inbox and references to the platform.
